2610.09934.title: Itgan at NADI 2026 shared task: Parameter-Efficient Whisper Adaptation for Robust, Mixed-Dialect and Code-Switched Arabic ASR
2610.09934.paper_summary: We describe the Itgan systems for the three ASR subtasks of NADI 2026, namely robust country-level ASR (1.1), mixed-dialect ASR (1.2), and Tunisian code-switched ASR (1.3). All three share one recipe, Whisper adapted with LoRA on consumer GPUs, and each was carried by a different addition to it. On 1.1, where the dialect label is given at test time, per-dialect specialists continued from a pooled adapter gave the largest gain, and the submitted system reached 57.1% country-average WER. A post-evaluation linear probe on frozen encoder features routes utterances without the label and recovers 44% of what oracle routing gives. On 1.2 the choice of base model mattered more than adapter capacity, and system combination helped only once we added a decorrelated member, reaching 46.7% WER. On 1.3 our system placed second at 14.49% WER with the lowest CER among the leading submissions, 5.38%. Its last 0.60 WER points came without further training, mostly from an exact weight-space average of independently trained runs, with ROVER voting adding the remainder. Every comparison carries a paired-bootstrap test, and we report eight directions that did not work.
2610.09934.paper_summary_zh: 我們描述了 Itgan 系統在 NADI 2026 的三個 ASR 子任務，即穩健的國家級 ASR (1.1)、混合方言 ASR (1.2) 和突尼西亞語代碼切換 ASR (1.3)。這三者共享一個配方，即在消費者 GPU 上適應 LoRA 的 Whisper，每個系統都有不同的附加功能。在 1.1 中，當方言標籤在測試時給出時，從池化適配器繼續的每個方言專家獲得了最大的增益，提交的系統達到了 57.1% 的國家平均 WER。對凍結編碼器特徵的後評估線性探測器在沒有標籤的情況下路由話語，並恢復了 44% 的預測路由所提供的內容。在 1.2 中，基礎模型的選擇比適配器的容量更為重要，系統組合只有在我們添加了一個去相關的成員後才有幫助，達到了 46.7% 的 WER。在 1.3 中，我們的系統以 14.49% 的 WER 排名第二，並在主要提交中擁有最低的 CER，為 5.38%。其最後的 0.60 WER 點數來自於沒有進一步訓練的情況，主要來自獨立訓練運行的精確權重空間平均值，ROVER 投票則增加了其餘部分。每個比較都進行了配對自助測試，我們報告了八個未成功的方向。
2610.09934.author: Ibrahim Almajai et.al.
